citation.journal: Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery Global Open

record.population: 18 patients with tightly curled afro-textured hair
record.design: Retrospective case series of follicular unit extraction (FUE) punches
record.finding: Sharp and dull conventional rotary punches failed or had excessive transection rates in 8 patients; a 2-pronged curved non-rotary punch had the best transection rate, below 5%, in all instances.
record.note: Small retrospective case series by the tool's developer group; technical result, not hair survival.
